name: updateLocationsFieldValueAdvanced
description: Fills in or changes extra fields on several locations at once, using ids.

locationId.description: The location's id, as shown in search results.

fieldId.description: The location field's id, as the plugin's settings give it.

value.description: The field's new value, checked by the field's type: a phone number, an email address, a web address (https:// is added when missing) or text. Leave it out to keep the current value, or leave it empty to empty it, unless the field is required.

customLabel.description: A label shown instead of the field's own, only for fields that allow one. Leave it out to keep the current label, or leave it empty to remove it.

locations.description: The field values to set, up to 50 per call, each exactly as a single change would be.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with each entry's outcome.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when any entry is invalid, does not resolve or repeats a location and field, in which case nothing is changed.

locations.description: One outcome per input entry, in input order.

index.description: The entry's position in the input list, from 0.

id.description: The location's id, if it worked.

error.description: Why the entry failed, if it didn't.
